principle: Continuously improve the balance of soft guidance, trust posture, and host-boundary clarity without reducing project-space autonomy.
guardrails: project-space work should remain broadly free
host-boundary protection should stay narrow and firm
soft guidance should remain advisory unless true host risk is involved
policy adjustments should be reversible and evidence-based
rule: Use evidence to rebalance policy guidance and trust posture while preserving autonomy-first behavior.
